svg.title: OpenDengue SEA Pipeline — Filter, Imputation, and Moran's I
svg.desc: A vertical flowchart illustrating the five-stage dengue data pipeline: country filtering, date selection, name harmonization, node definition, completeness labeling, and Moran's I spatial autocorrelation.

g.text: Malaysia · Indonesia · Viet Nam · Thailand · Philippines · Singapore · Lao PDR · Cambodia · Myanmar · Brunei
3 · Harmonise names: Admin-1 ↔ GAUL FAO spelling
Admin-1 provinces for: Malaysia · Indonesia · Thailand · Philippines · Myanmar · Brunei
Whole country = 1 node for: Singapore · Viet Nam · Lao PDR · Cambodia

svg.text: Where provincial annual totals = 0 → monthly values set to 0, labeled OBSERVED

g.text: Measures clustering of dengue counts across Admin-1 nodes
I = (N / W) · Σᵢ Σⱼ wᵢⱼ (xᵢ − x̄)(xⱼ − x̄) / Σᵢ(xᵢ − x̄)²

svg.text: wᵢⱼ = spatial weight matrix (queen contiguity or inverse-distance)
Computed per month · significance tested via permutation (999 runs)
